name: Equal jitter
summary: Half the exponential delay fixed, half of it random. Guarantees a floor that grows with the attempt, where full jitter can return zero every time.

params.name: baseMs
params.description: The first ceiling, doubled on each subsequent attempt.

params.name: capMs
params.description: No ceiling exceeds this, however many attempts have failed.

params.name: maxAttempts
params.description: Give up after this many attempts.

notes: A delay always falls in [half, 2 x half], averaging about three quarters of the un-jittered ceiling against full jitter's one half. Choose it when the backoff must actually back off.
